title: leonurus cardiaca var. villosus
intro: Leonurus cardiaca var. villosus, commonly known as Wood Betony, is a variety of the Leonurus cardiaca plant, a species of flowering plant in the mint family. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing anxiety and stress, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of menopausal hot flashes. The therapeutic actions of Leonurus cardiaca var. villosus include acting as a mild sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids. The health benefits of Leonurus cardiaca var. villosus include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral properties.
